description: This file contains functions for managing and creating chart of accounts in an ERP system, including generating account trees, importing accounts from templates, and validating bank accounts.

methods.name: create_charts
methods.description: Creates chart of accounts for a company based on a template or existing company, importing accounts and rebuilding the account tree.

methods.name: add_suffix_if_duplicate
methods.description: Adds a suffix to account name if it duplicates an existing account name in the list.

methods.name: identify_is_group
methods.description: Determines if a child account is a group account based on its properties.

methods.name: get_chart
methods.description: Retrieves a chart of accounts based on a template name or existing company.

methods.name: get_charts_for_country
methods.description: Fetches available chart templates for a specified country, optionally including standard charts.

methods.name: get_account_tree_from_existing_company
methods.description: Builds an account hierarchy tree for an existing company.

methods.name: build_account_tree
methods.description: Recursively constructs a nested account tree structure.

methods.name: validate_bank_account
methods.description: Checks if a bank account exists within a specified chart of accounts.

methods.name: build_tree_from_json
methods.description: Parses a chart template JSON into a parent-child account list for rendering.
